commit.subject: LU-18357 tests: skip sanity-sec/27a+27b in interop
commit.message:
LU-18357 tests: skip sanity-sec/27a+27b in interop

Skip sanity-sec.sh test_27a and test_27b when running interop tests
with old clients.  The format of the fileset output was changed
when it gained support for multiple fileset export.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Test-Parameters: testlist=sanity-sec clientversion=2.16 env=ONLY=27,HONOR_EXCEPT=y
